addons.fullDescription:

addons.name: Tab Image Saver
addons.description: Save images from open tabs. Default action saves largest image in active tab, with options to act on tabs to the left or right of the active tab.
addons.fullDescription:
Tab Image Saver makes it easy to save images from multiple browser tabs.

⚠ Images can only be saved within the default downloads directory - this is a restriction of the Firefox WebExtensions API.

If this addon is not working as expected please report your issue on Github.

Features:
By default this addon saves the largest image found on the active tab.
You may control how this functions by changing the addon preferences at in Firefox > Add-ons > Extensions > Tab Image Saver > Preferences

    - Multitasking Support - run addon concurrently in separate windows
    - Right Click addon icon context menu for quick access to preferences
    - Keyboard shortcut option
    - Select from active tab, tabs to the left/right of current tab, or all tabs.
    - Cancel addon operation by clicking addon icon
    - Set minimum image size in pixels
    - Option to only save tabs with images, ignoring tabs with webpages
    - Filenames renamed automatically
    - Display badge on icon with showing progress and count of downloads
    - Close tabs after saving
    - Hide saved images from download history
    - Show notification when complete


Permissions:

    - Access your data for all websites:
    This is required to allow the addon to work on any website. The addon does not inspect websites until you choose to save images from tabs.
    - Download files and read and modify the browser's download history:
    This addon downloads images and can optionally remove completed downloads from your history. It will only remove downloads from history that were created from this addon and does not read your download history.
    - Display notifications to you:
    A notification will display when the addon finishes processing and downloading. This notification can be disabled in the addon options.
    - Access browser tabs:
    This addon only accesses tabs when you select the addon to begin and only processes tabs attached to the selected window.


Addon icon: images by lastspark from the Noun Project.

addons.name: Video Downloader - Video Hunter
addons.description: Video Hunter Downloader – download videos from the Internet.
addons.fullDescription:
Introducing Video Hunter Downloader, a comprehensive tool for seamlessly downloading and managing videos from websites. Here's an overview of its features:

Download and Save: Effortlessly download and save videos playing on websites directly to your hard disk.

QR Code Download to Phone: Download videos to your phone using a QR code for added convenience.

Resolution Selection: Choose from different resolutions, especially on supported sites like Vimeo, to tailor your viewing experience.

Chromecast and Google Home Compatibility: Enjoy watching discovered MP4 videos on your TV via Google Chromecast or play them on your Google Home.

Supported Formats: Video Hunter Downloader supports various formats, including MP4, FLV, MPD, HLV, WebM, MOV, MKV, WMA, WAV, M4A, OGG, OGV, ACC. It also acts as an HLS streaming downloader, detecting M3U8 files and consolidating them into MP4 format.

If you encounter any issues or have videos that cannot be downloaded, please reach out via email to getvideohunter@gmail.com. Your feedback is crucial for improving the software.

Download video and music effortlessly from popular platforms like YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, OnlyFans, Netflix, Twitter, Udemy, Coursera, and Pornhub with Video Hunter extension.

Privacy Policy:
Video Hunter Downloader prioritizes user privacy and does not collect or transmit any personal data. Non-personalized data, such as the video address or parts thereof, may be sent in specific instances, including when manually adding videos to the list, playing a video in the list, or opening the Video Hunter Downloader menu. Additionally, on some supported video sites, the software may load additional information to obtain video file addresses.

addons.name: Popup Blocker (strict)
addons.description: Strictly block all popup requests from any website by default. A notification window is opened to allow you accept, reject, open the popup in background page, or redirect the current page to popup address
addons.fullDescription:
Popup Blocker (strict) is a lightweight WebExtension to prevent websites from opening popups. The extension pauses all sorts of window opening requests for user attention. You can either accept or deny a request. Multiple unique requests are shown combined. If a website requests a single URL more than once, a badge number will be shown indicating the total number of requests to this particular URL.

Preview:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jp-RaiTHzCQ

Options:
Deny popup request
Allow popup request
Open popup request in a background tab
Redirect current page to popup URL source

Supported blocking methods:
window.open
a -> target[_blank]
iframe -> submit

---

For FAQs please go to:
https://webextension.org/listing/popup-blocker.html

For bug reports please go to:
https://github.com/schomery/popup-blocker/issues

To check your current popup blocker visit:
https://webbrowsertools.com/popup-blocker/

---
You can now translate Popup Blocker (strict) into your language; https://www.transifex.com/github-7/popup-blocker-strict/dashboard/
---

addons.name: uBlock Origin
addons.description: Finally, an efficient wide-spectrum content blocker. Easy on CPU and memory.
addons.fullDescription:
uBlock Origin is not an "ad blocker", it's a wide-spectrum content blocker with CPU and memory efficiency as a primary feature.



Out of the box, uBO blocks ads, trackers, coin miners, popups, etc. through the following lists of filters, enabled by default:

    EasyList (ads)
    EasyPrivacy (tracking)
    Peter Lowe’s Ad server list (ads and tracking)
    Online Malicious URL Blocklist
    uBO's own lists


More lists are available for you to select if you wish:

    EasyList Cookie
    Fanboy Annoyances
    AdGuard Annoyances
    Dan Pollock’s hosts file
    And many others


Additionally, you can point-and-click to block JavaScript locally or globally, create your own global or local rules to override entries from filter lists, and many more advanced features.



Free.
Open source with public license (GPLv3)
For users by users.

If ever you really do want to contribute something, think about the people working hard to maintain the filter lists you are using, which were made available to use by all for free.


    Documentation
    Release notes
    Community support @ Reddit
    Contributors @ GitHub
    Contributors @ Crowdin

addons.name: ClearURLs
addons.description: Automatically removes tracking parameters from URLs
addons.fullDescription:
Automatically remove tracking parameters from URLs and browse with cleaner links.

ClearURLs automatically removes known tracking parameters from URLs while you browse, helping prevent unnecessary tracking and making links cleaner and easier to share.

    Automatically removes known tracking parameters
    Skips known tracking redirects when possible
    Open source and built with privacy in mind
    Does not collect your browsing or usage data


How does it work?

Websites often add tracking parameters to URLs to measure clicks, identify where visitors came from, or associate browsing activity with advertising and analytics campaigns.

For example:

https://example.com/?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=sale


ClearURLs removes the known tracking parameters:

https://example.com/


The destination remains the same, while unnecessary tracking information is removed.

Features

    Automatically removes known tracking elements from URLs
    Skips known tracking redirects and takes you directly to the destination when possible
    Adds a context menu option for copying cleaned links
    Includes a built in tool for cleaning multiple URLs at once
    Blocks hyperlink auditing, also known as ping tracking
    Prevents tracking parameters from being injected through the History API
    Prevents Google and Yandex from rewriting search result links to include tracking elements
    Optionally blocks some common advertising domains


Privacy

ClearURLs is designed to protect your privacy.

We do not collect your browsing or usage data.

ClearURLs is completely open source. Anyone can inspect the source code, see how the extension works, report problems, or contribute to the project.

View the source code on GitHub

Permissions

ClearURLs requires certain browser permissions to detect and clean URLs while you browse.

Learn why ClearURLs needs these permissions

Support and feedback

If you encounter a problem, find a bug, or have a suggestion, please let us know on GitHub.

Report an issue or suggest an improvement

For additional information, visit the ClearURLs documentation.

You can also view the complete changelog on GitHub.

addons.name: Consent-O-Matic
addons.description: Automatic handling of GDPR consent forms
addons.fullDescription:
Cookie pop-ups are designed to be confusing and make you 'agree' to be tracked. This add-on automatically answers consent pop-ups for you, so you can't be manipulated. Set your preferences once, and let the technology do the rest!

This add-on is built and maintained by workers at Aarhus University in Denmark. We are privacy researchers that got tired of seeing how companies violate the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Because the organisations that enforce the GDPR do not have enough resources, we built this add-on to help them out.

We looked at 680 pop-ups and combined their data processing purposes into 5 categories that you can toggle on or off. Sometimes our categories don't perfectly match those on the website, so then we will choose the more privacy preserving option.

addons.name: I don't care about cookies
addons.description: Get rid of cookie warnings from almost all websites!
addons.fullDescription:
The EU regulations require that any website using tracking cookies must get user's permission before installing them. These warnings appear on most websites until the visitor agrees with the website's terms and conditions. Imagine how irritating that becomes when you surf anonymously or if you delete cookies automatically every time you close the browser.

This add-on will remove these cookie warnings from almost all websites! You can report any website which still warns you about cookies: just click 'Report a cookie warning' from the extension menu (the brown cookie image next to your address bar).

In most cases, the add-on just blocks or hides cookie related pop-ups. When it's needed for the website to work properly, it will automatically accept the cookie policy for you (sometimes it will accept all and sometimes only necessary cookie categories, depending on what's easier to do). It doesn't delete cookies.

Other browsers are supported too. Check https://www.i-dont-care-about-cookies.eu/ for info and support.

PRIVACY POLICY RELATED:

If the user chooses "Report a cookie warning" from the menu, this add-on collects only the URL of the current page and redirects user to the reporting page.

IMPORTANT: there is no private or otherwise data collection, data transfer or data sharing with 3rd parties whatsoever.

Get rid of these with "I don't care about cookies" browser extension.

addons.name: DuckDuckGo Search & Tracker Protection
addons.description: ⚡Protects your data. Private search with optional AI, private browsing, and ad blocking.
addons.fullDescription:
At DuckDuckGo, we believe the best way to protect your personal information from hackers, scammers, and privacy-invasive companies is to stop it from being collected at all. That's why millions of people choose DuckDuckGo over other browser extensions to protect their searching and browsing. Our built-in search engine is like Google but never tracks your searches. Our browsing protections, such as ad tracker blocking and cookie blocking, help stop other companies from collecting your data. While our optional integrated AI features, Search Assist and Duck.ai, are private and never use your data to train AI. Oh, and our browser extension is free — we make money from privacy-respecting search ads, not by exploiting your data. Take back control of your personal information with the browser extension designed for data protection.  
 
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS  
Protect Your Searches by Default: Install the extension and we’ll set your default search engine and homepage to DuckDuckGo Search, so you can easily search online without being tracked.  
 
Shield Your Browsing History: Our 3rd-Party Tracker Loading Protection blocks most trackers before they load, greatly exceeding what most browsers offer by default. 
 
Chat Privately With AI: Duck.ai lets you have private conversations with 3rd-party AI models, anonymized by us and never used to train AI.   
 
Secure Your Email (Optional): Use Email Protection to block most email trackers and hide your existing email address with @duck.com addresses.  
 
Automatically Enforce Encryption: Shield your data from network and Wi-Fi snoopers by forcing many sites to use an HTTPS connection.  
 
Escape Fingerprinting: Make it harder for companies to create a unique identifier for you by blocking attempts to combine info about your browser and device.  
 
Block Tracking Cookies: prevents most 3rd-party cookies from tracking you as you browse from site to site.  
 
We feature many protections not available on most browsers and extensions, even in private browsing mode, including protection from link tracking, Global Privacy Control, and more. 
 
You don't need to wait to take control of your personal information! Join the millions of people using DuckDuckGo to protect their everyday searching, browsing, and emailing. 
 
Read more about our free Tracking Protections at https://help.duckduckgo.com/privacy/web-tracking-protections 
 
Privacy Policy: https://duckduckgo.com/privacy/ 
 
Terms of Service: https://duckduckgo.com/terms 
 
Note about 3rd-Party Tracker Protection and Search Ads: while there are some limitations following search ad clicks, viewing ads on DuckDuckGo search is anonymous. Learn more here https://help.duckduckgo.com/privacy/web-tracking-protections

addons.name: TWP - Translate Web Pages
addons.description:
Translate your page in real time using Google, Bing or Yandex.
It is not necessary to open new tabs.
addons.fullDescription:
What can the TWP extension do?

    Your page is translated in one click without opening new tabs.
    Translate PDF documents.
    Translate selected text.
    Multiple translation services are supported.


Why do you need to access your data on all the websites you visit?
This permission is required to translate the websites.

How are the pages translated?
Pages are translated in real time using the translation service of your choice.

And how's my privacy?
Privacy policy We do not collect any data. However, the translation is done using third-party services and they may collect data to improve their services.

Limitations
Some pages like support.mozilla.org and addons.mozilla.org will not be translated. For security reasons, the browser blocks extensions from accessing these sites.

How can I help you?

    Patreon To help this project financially.
    GitHub To report bugs and contribute to the extension's source code.
    Crowdin For interface localization.
